name: Ultimate Stock Portfolio Analyzer - Daily Report

nodes.name: Daily 6AM EST (Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Runs Monday-Friday at 6:00 AM. Make sure your n8n instance timezone is set to America/New_York (EST) in Settings > General. The cron expression '0 6 * * 1-5' means: minute 0, hour 6, any day of month, any month, Monday(1) through Friday(5).

nodes.name: Run Portfolio Analyzer
nodes.notes: Executes the portfolio analyzer script. Timeout set to 300s (5 min) to allow for Yahoo Finance API calls. The --no-details flag skips verbose per-stock output. Results are exported as JSON to /tmp/portfolio_results.json.

nodes.name: Read Results JSON
nodes.notes: Reads the exported JSON results file produced by the analyzer.

nodes.name: Parse JSON Results
nodes.notes: Parses the raw JSON and extracts: macro signal, recession probability, verdict counts, top 3 stocks, earnings alerts (within 7 days), and the full sorted portfolio summary.

nodes.name: Format Summary Message
nodes.notes: Builds a clean, human-readable summary message with header, macro status, verdict counts, top picks table, earnings alerts, and full portfolio sorted by score.

nodes.name: Send to Slack
nodes.notes: SETUP REQUIRED: Set the environment variable SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in your n8n instance, or replace the URL directly. To get a webhook URL: 1) Go to api.slack.com/apps, 2) Create or select an app, 3) Enable Incoming Webhooks, 4) Add a webhook to your target channel, 5) Copy the URL.

nodes.name: Format Error Message
nodes.notes: Formats a clear error notification when the analyzer script fails, including the exit code and stderr output.

nodes.name: Send Error to Slack
nodes.notes: Sends the error notification to Slack using the same webhook.
